bank_name: National Credit and Commerce Bank PLC
period_note: Half-Yearly unaudited report used as the project's Q2 data point. Cumulative-from-Jan-1 convention established from the filing's own column header '01 January to 30 June 2023'. Standalone/Solo basis. Source PDF (half_yearly_report_2023.pdf) is a scanned/OCR document whose embedded pdftotext text layer was badly corrupted; all figures below were sourced via direct visual inspection of 350dpi page renders of the standalone Balance Sheet (source page 7) and Profit and Loss Account (source page 9), both independently verified fully internally consistent (balance sheet ties to the taka: Total Liabilities 287,804,150,731 + Total Shareholders' Equity 24,192,775,735 = Total Assets 311,996,926,465; Profit before tax 2,801,344,531 - Provision for tax 1,230,260,381 = Net Profit after tax 1,571,084,150). As in the 2023_Q1 filing, 'Interest on perpetual bonds' (BDT 249.29mn) is shown as a post-tax appropriation, and the reported EPS of 1.49 is on the FULL Net Profit after tax (1,571,084,150 / 1,057,545,805 shares), not net of that item. Cross-check: comparative '31 December 2022' column (Total Assets BDT 301,807.57mn, Total Equity BDT 23,032.61mn) matches the existing bank_financials/NCCBANK/quarterly/2022_Q4.json exactly.

source.source_page_lines: Source PDF page 7 (Balance Sheet, 'As at 30 June 2023') and page 9 (Profit and Loss Account, 'For the period ended 30 June 2023'). pdftotext -layout text layer was badly corrupted (systematic OCR digit-substitution errors); figures verified via direct visual inspection of 350dpi page renders instead of the text layer.
